## Announcements 

::: {.callout-important}

The second midterm takes place this weekend. You will work with a **Spark cluster on your EC2 instance**.

This will be a take home exam, with a duration of 2 hours. When you fork this repo from GH Classroom, it will generate an initial commit will a timestamp. You will 
be graded based on the **last commit within 2 hours of the start time**. You may do this exam at any time between Friday, April 17 and Monday, April 20, but it must be done by Monday, April 20 at 11:59pm. 

The link for the midterm will be **available on Blackboard in the Week 12 space** after midnight tonight. 

Because of the emphasis on commit times, please commit often to make sure your work will be graded, even for partial credits.

* Open notes, open internet — **no AI assistance**
